title: Kth Largest Element
description: Write a Zig program that finds the 3rd largest element in an unsorted array by sorting it first.
hints: Zig's standard library provides `std.sort.block` for sorting
Sort in descending order by passing a custom comparison function
The comparison function signature: `fn lessThan(void, a: T, b: T) bool`
Anonymous structs can define inline functions: `struct {}.fnName`
